title: Addition (up to 20)
description: Class 1 IMO — Addition up to 20: counting on, adding zero, order of addition and word problems, with olympiad reasoning and everyday-maths practice.

topics.title: Adding by Counting On
topics.concept:
Addition means putting two groups together to find how many there are in all. We use the sign + (plus) and = (equals) to show the total.

An easy way to add is to count on. To add 5 + 3, start at 5 and count on three more: 6, 7, 8. So 5 + 3 = 8.

examples.solution: Start at 6 and count on 2 more: 7, 8. So 6 + 2 = 8.

recap: Addition (+) joins groups to find the total.
Count on from a number to add quickly.
The answer comes after the = sign.

topics.title: Order of Addition and Adding Zero
topics.concept:
When we add, the order does not matter. 4 + 6 gives the same answer as 6 + 4 — both equal 10.

Adding zero changes nothing: 8 + 0 = 8, because zero means 'none added'.

examples.solution: Adding zero keeps the number the same, so 5 + 0 = 5.

recap: Order does not change the sum: 6 + 3 = 3 + 6.

quiz.explanation: Adding zero keeps the number the same: 9 + 0 = 9.

topics.title: Addition Word Problems
topics.concept: In real life we add to find a total. Words like in all, altogether and total tell us to add the amounts.

examples.problem: Riya has 4 red balloons and 5 blue balloons. How many in all?
A plate has 7 idlis. Amma adds 3 more. How many now?

recap: Add the two amounts to get the total.

quiz.q: Aarav has 5 marbles. A friend gives him 4 more. How many marbles now?
There are 6 boys and 6 girls. How many children in all?

questions.q: A box has 7 pens. You put in 5 more. How many pens are in the box?
Meera reads 4 pages in the morning and 6 pages at night. How many pages in all?
A bus has 8 people. At the next stop 4 more get in. How many people now?
I add 3 to a number and get 11. What is the number?
Aarav got 5 more stickers and now has 12. How many did he have at first?
questions.explanation: 7 + 5 = 12, so he had 7 to begin with.
